# Invest Gulf

> Independent research on UAE and Gulf property investment for foreign buyers: fees, yields, Golden Visa, off-plan risks, and cross-market comparisons.

- Site: https://invest-gulf.com
- Contact: info@invest-gulf.com
- Focus: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bahrain property investment
- Not a developer, not a listing portal
